stem: The random variable $X$ has the distribution $\text{B}\left(8, \frac{3}{4}\right)$. A random sample of 100 values of $X$ is chosen, and the sample mean, $\bar{X}$, is found.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Find $\text{P}(\bar{X} > 6.2)$. You are **not** expected to use a continuity correction.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: State why the Central Limit Theorem was needed in the calculation in part **(a)**.
